emotion_and_vibe: High-tech mission-control, industrial precision, cyberpunk undertones. It should feel like a real-time, professional robotic fleet command center.

headings.usage: Use for all main headers, section titles, and widget headers.

body.usage: Use for descriptions, standard text, and documentation.

data_points.usage: Use for logs, metrics, coordinates, time indicators, and algorithm outputs.

surfaces.panels: Flat solid dark backgrounds (#0A0B10) with sharp 1px borders (#1F2937). Avoid heavy shadows in dark mode; use borders to establish hierarchy. Add 2px inner glow highlights for 'active' panels.
surfaces.glass: For sticky headers or floating overlays: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and a border-white/10.
surfaces.grid_lines: Subtle #1F2937 grid lines on the background to enhance the technical 'blueprint' feel.

textures.noise: Optional subtle noise overlay on the hero section to kill digital flatness.
textures.glow: Apply drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_currentColor] on critical accent text or active nodes to create a neon bleed effect.

dashboard_grid.base_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column complex bento layout.
dashboard_grid.rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children. No jagged bottoms.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use precise, mathematical spacing (p-4, p-6). Avoid massive whitespace in the dashboard view; keep it dense but clearly separated by 1px borders.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense data, logs, and forms. Center-align main hero text.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transitions: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-150. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hovering over a panel should slightly lighten its background and border. Buttons should have distinct hover states with increased text contrast.
motion_and_interactions.simulation_motion: AMR movements in the grid should be animated smoothly using CSS transitions or Framer Motion between cell coordinates.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Blinking cursors for logs, pulse animations for critical warnings (red/orange statuses).

components.simulation_grid: A 2D cell matrix representing the warehouse. Use CSS Grid or HTML Canvas. Each cell shows obstacles, racks, and AMR positions. AMRs should be distinct circles/icons with glowing borders based on state.
components.control_bar: Fixed or sticky panel with Play/Pause, Step, Reset buttons, Speed Slider, and Tick Counter.
components.event_log: A scrolling terminal-like window. Uses JetBrains Mono. Color-code log lines based on event type (e.g., [CRITICAL], [INFO]).
components.cards: Cardless style. Rectangular dense blocks with strict borders. No border radius (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
components.charts: Recharts for Baseline vs System performance. Dark theme, remove default Cartesian grid lines, use single distinct accent colors.

images.usage: Hero section background with a heavy dark gradient overlay (bg-black/80 to bg-black/60) to ensure text readability.
Texture overlay or section background for the simulation area.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons (play, pause, settings, warning, battery).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text should be at least #9CA3AF on #050505.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='play-simulation-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete multi-page or deep single-page application using React and Tailwind CSS. The file extensions must be .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx.
Create a Landing Page Hero introducing SIH Problem 26123, then transition seamlessly into the Dashboard.
The Dashboard must include a live warehouse simulation grid where users can place robots, obstacles, and assign parameters.
Include a 'Scenario Selector' to trigger specific algorithms (Collision, Deadlock, Reroute, Battery-dead, Task Manager election).
Implement the 'Event Log' terminal with auto-scrolling to display real-time algorithm decisions.
Use Recharts to build the performance comparison chart.
Follow the exact dark theme palette provided. Use absolute black/dark navy, NOT gray.
Avoid using generic Shadcn cards with large padding. Use tight, border-bound dense layouts.
Ensure all data_testids are implemented as per rules.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px sharp borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, selection states.
Prioritize using pre-existing components when applicable. Create new components matching the style of the project.
